title: A2A Protocol Error Structures
description: ProtocolError and related error handling structures

ProtocolError.description: The ProtocolError object represents an error encountered during protocol processing

code.description: Error code identifier for categorizing the error

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong

file.description: File path where the error occurred (if applicable)

line.description: Line number where the error occurred (if applicable)

ProtocolErrorArray.description: Array of ProtocolError objects used in context blocks
